name: integral2
comment: Sig: q = integral2(fn,a,b,c,d) / integral3(fn,a,b,c,d,e,f) / quadgk(fn,a,b) / quad2d(fn,a,b,c,d). Multi-dimensional numerical integration by nesting the adaptive 1-D Gauss-Kronrod integral: integral2 iterates an inner y-sweep inside an outer x-sweep; integral3 triple-nests; quadgk = the 1-D integral; quad2d = the older name for integral2. For smooth integrands this matches MATLAB to absTol. Fingerprint: integral2(x*y,[0,1]^2)=0.25, integral2(exp(x*y),[0,1]^2)=1.317902151454, integral3(x+y+z,[0,1]^3)=1.5, quadgk(exp(-x^2),0,1)=0.746824132812427, quad2d(x*y)=0.25. Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes bugs/builtin/numerical-integration-nd.
